result.title: Composable Causality: A Toolkit for Systematic Time-Series Causal Discovery and Treatment-Effect Benchmarking
result.comment: 30 pages, 10 main text pages plus references and appendices, with figures and tables. Accepted to the NeurIPS 2026 Evaluations and Datasets Track. Code and data at https://github.com/hferdous/Composable_Causality
result.summary: Real-world multivariate time series rarely come with verified ground-truth causal structure, so research on time-series causal discovery and treatment-effect estimation depends on synthetic data. Existing tools are either fixed datasets that cannot be modified after release or script-based generators in which each script fixes one combination of mechanism, confounding, and missingness. Neither supports controlled experiments that vary a single property, such as sparsity, noise distribution, or missingness mechanism, while holding the others fixed. Counterfactual evaluation has the same gap, since existing simulators are built per paper with hardcoded mechanisms or produce observational data only. We introduce DTCD (Datasets and Toolkit for Causal Discovery), a data generation library that produces multivariate time series with ground-truth contemporaneous and lagged adjacency matrices. Topology, mechanism, noise, observational mask, and intervention policy are independent components that compose through configuration alone. Paired counterfactual twins, produced by caching the stochastic realization during the factual rollout and re-injecting it during the interventional rollout, recover individual treatment effects to numerical precision. A reference benchmark of eight discovery algorithms on eighty-one configurations and four treatment-effect estimators on eighteen configurations exposes failure modes that aggregate metrics hide. These include the inability of standard discovery methods to handle missing values, regardless of whether the missingness mechanism is informative, and a marginal-variance shortcut (varsortability) that we measure and remove by standardization. Code and data: https://github.com/hferdous/Composable_Causality

AI.brief_summary: 该文提出 DTCD，一个把拓扑、机制、噪声、观测掩码与干预策略拆为可独立组合组件的多变量时间序列数据生成库，并附带因果发现与处理效应估计的基准评测。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「单属性受控变化」的生成思路与成对反事实孪生（缓存同一随机实现）可能可供核查：用于构造只改变某一视觉证据或缺失机制的配对样本，从而检验 latent 内容对答案的因果贡献与视觉证据筛选的稳健性。
